method: Heat a little ghee in a pan and roast the rava until fragrant and lightly golden.
Add the milk and sugar to the roasted rava. Cook on low heat, stirring continuously, until the mixture thickens and reaches a halwa-like consistency.
Remove from heat. Thinly slice the roasted almonds and cashews.
While the mixture is still warm, form small balls (laddus).
Decorate each laddu with sliced badam, cashew, and a raisin. Add cardamom powder for flavor.
notes: Note: The Tamil title in the original snippet is written as 'ரவ் பாதா சாக்', which is preserved here.
